Plot GnRH Marker Program Results

Source: R/visualization.R
plot_gnrh_marker_programs.Rd

Visualize candidate GnRH marker programs generated by gnrh_marker_programs.

Usage

plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = c("summary", "high_confidence", "candidate_table"),
  type = c("bar", "dot", "tile"),
  min_genes = 1,
  style = "classic",
  mode = "light",
  txtsize = 12,
  x.ang = 45
)

Arguments

programs

Output list returned by gnrh_marker_programs.

table

Character. Which result table to visualize. One of "summary", "high_confidence", or "candidate_table". Default is "summary".

type

Character. Plot type to generate. One of "bar", "dot", or "tile". For gene-level tables ("high_confidence" or "candidate_table"), this argument is ignored and a gene-level dotplot is returned.

min_genes

Integer. Minimum number of genes required for a program/dataset combination to be displayed when table = "summary". Default is 1.

style

Character. Theme style passed to plot_theme. One of "classic", "minimal", "bw", "test", "void", "dirty", or "gray". Default is "classic".

mode

Character. Theme mode passed to plot_theme. One of "light" or "dark". Default is "light".

txtsize

Numeric. Base text size passed to plot_theme. Default is 12.

x.ang

Numeric. Rotation angle for x-axis labels. Default is 45.

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Details

This function generates publication-ready plots summarizing candidate GnRH-associated marker genes, developmental programs, confidence levels, and dataset-specific marker signatures.

When table = "summary", three plot types are available:

  • type = "bar": barplot of candidate marker counts per developmental program, faceted by dataset.

  • type = "dot": dotplot showing developmental program enrichment across datasets.

  • type = "tile": heatmap-like tile plot showing the number of candidate genes per developmental program and dataset.

When table = "high_confidence" or table = "candidate_table", the function returns a gene-level dotplot with genes on the y-axis, developmental programs on the x-axis, point color representing confidence level, and point size representing specificity score.

The plotting theme is controlled by plot_theme, the internal GnRHcell theme system.

See also

gnrh_marker_programs, gnrh_stage_modules, gene_upset, plot_theme

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
programs <- gnrh_marker_programs(
  files = files,
  results = overlap,
  outdir = outdir
)

# Summary barplot
p1 <- plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = "summary",
  type = "bar"
)

# Summary dotplot
p2 <- plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = "summary",
  type = "dot"
)

# Summary tile plot
p3 <- plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = "summary",
  type = "tile"
)

# High-confidence gene-level plot
p4 <- plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = "high_confidence"
)

# Dark mode
p5 <- plot_gnrh_marker_programs(
  programs,
  table = "summary",
  type = "dot",
  mode = "dark"
)
} # }
